name: SuperSupermartShoppingTrip
source:
As I walk up to the doors of the Super Supermart I hear a disembodied voice in my head. `` Welcome to Super Supermart.'' I look to the right of the store's front door. There was a man with a slender physique dressed in a blue, white, and grey skin tight costume with a white mask. Over which he wore the Super Supermart grass green, one size fits all, polyester vest. It was too big. 
 
 He raised his right arm and made a slight waving motion with his hand. The doors slid open in front of me and I walked in, taking the scrap of paper from my pocket that I had written my shopping list on. 
 
 I grabbed one of the anti-grav shopping carts from the corral. The holo-flyer activated when I put both my hands on the handlebar. Dr.Robotroid's insignia flashed across the air a few inches above the handlebar before the flyer materialised. I stared over the top of the flashing images so I could steer my cart without hitting anybody. 
 
 First stop was men's wear. On the way I saw a woman point to a box on a high shelf, out of reach. The store employee next to her, a person in a bulky futuristic battle armour activated their rockets, flew up and got the box for her. 
 
 `` Come try our free samples.'' a teenage girl and boy at a food table called out. They shared the same blonde hair and fair skin. I took one of the tiny cups of ice cream from the girl's tray, trying not to look at her breasts in her skin tight ice blue costume. A man directly in front of the table with an unkempt beard was n't trying quite so hard. 
 
 `` Do you have toppings as well?'' the man asked. 
 
 `` Yes.'' the girl replied, hiding a look of disgust and exasperation. `` We have many flavours of sprinkles to choose from. Would you like some Chunky Chocolate?'' 
 
 `` No, I prefer gumdrops.'' the man said, his mouth widening into a leer. `` I love them when they harden and stiffen in the cold.'' 
 
 The girl folded her arms over her chest and took a step back from the table. The boy erupted in flame and sent a mini fireball into the man's beard. `` I warned you.'' he shouted angrily. 
 
 `` Aaaaah!'' the man yelped and tried to pat out the flames with his meaty hands. 
 
 `` Ha ha ha ha ha ha!'' I laughed and pointed at the man slapping his own face. Others joined in and pointed thier phones at him. 
 
 The man managed to get the fire out but his perverted actions cost him the portion of his beard under his chin and a good portion of his dignity. He looked like someone from Victorian England who grew his muttonchops too long. I left the man to face mob justice, forgoing the Inside-Out cheeseburger the boy had been barbecuing. 
 
 Over in men's wear I picked out some dress shirts that were on sale. 
 
 `` Are you finding everything okay, sir?'' I turned around to see a young man in a red spandex suit with the number'10' on his belt. 
 
 `` Yes, just fine.'' I say, waving my shirts in my hand. 
 
 The guy eyed what I was holding. `` Those look like the European fits, sir. They tend to run a size smaller than domestic. If you'll allow me I can measure you for a better fit.'' 
 
 `` Sure.'' I said, shrugging. 
 
 He motioned for me to raise my arms to the side and then he elongated his arms, snaking them around my body. They went around my neck, under my arms and around my chest, and around my waist. It was more than a little unnerving. 
 
 `` These should be a better fit.'' he reached two display counters over and picked up the same style of shirts I was holding. 
 
 `` Thanks.'' I reply, comparing the differences. The ones he picked were a size larger. I placed them in my anti-grav cart, noticing for the first time the anti-grav plates were shaped like Dr.Robotroid's face; their inventor. 
 
 Next I walked over to the shoe department. I grabbed the display shoe for the one I wanted and tracked down a salesperson. 
 
 `` Do you have this in a size ten?'' I asked. 
 
 `` Let me check the back for you.'' she said, pulling out a large gnarled twig from her belt pouch. She waved it around in the air, going slow and quick in circular motions. The tip glowed a deep green and a glowing, green, slightly translucent fox materialized at her side. She showed the spirit animal the shoe and said `` size 10.'' The apparition bounded through the wall. A moment later it bounded back through the wall with a shoebox inside it. The fox dissappeared completely and the box fell to the floor. The girl picked it up and placed it in my hand. 
 
 `` There you go. If you need anything else just let me know.'' 
 
 I nodded my thanks and went to try them on. They fit pretty well and I added it to the shirts in my cart. I strolled over to electronics there they were having a sale on computer monitors and USB drives. I grabbed a Dr.Robotroid Galaxy Navigator. `` 2 googelflops'' the package read. I hope it transfers files faster than the 1 googelflop I already had. 
 
 I go up to the counter and ask about the monitor I wanted. The guy at the desk typed some things into the computer. `` We have a few left.'' he said. If you'll give me just a second I'll get one for you. 
 
 A second later he dissappeared into thin air and then reappeared with my monitor in his hands. I thanked him, put the monitor in my cart and made my way to the checkout counter. I passed by the sample table from earlier. The girl was still there but the fire boy and the beardo were gone. 
 
 I used a self checkout machine and ticked off the `` Instant Delivery?'' when the option came up. As I bagged my purchases a girl with radient, flaming, orange hair and completely black eyes come up. `` You chose the Instant Delivery Option?'' she said, in a questioning tone. 
 
 `` Yes,'' I reply. `` I can carry them myself.'' The girl confirmed my address and then closed her eyes. She brought her hands close together and a violet ball of energy began to form and grow larger until it filled the space between her hands. I stepped to her side just in case. She flung her hands out in front of her. The energy ball flew out and expanded until it was just a little taller than me. The opaque colour faded away and I saw the door of my house. Then she beckoned me to step through. I did so, feeling my right foot land in the grass on my lawn while my left was still on the tiled floor of the store. As I stepped through completely I heard a voice in the head say `` Thank you for shopping at Super Supermart.''
retelling:
Narrated by The Woman on High Shelf:

In the towering heights of the Super Supermart, nestled amidst rows of boxes and trinkets, I found myself in a peculiar predicament. A cacophony of sounds echoed through the air, a symphony of futuristic hums, beeps, and voices that bordered on overwhelming. My eyes strained to adjust to the vibrant hues illuminated by the ever-present glow of neon lights.

From my lofty perch, I observed a stream of peculiar characters traversing the store. First, there was the enigmatic figure known as Dr. Robotroid, whose groundbreaking anti-grav technology allowed for the floating shopping carts that seemed to defy all laws of physics. Then came the Man in the Costume, a friendly and welcoming presence at the entrance, who greeted each shopper with a radiant smile and a firm handshake.

As I waited, I couldn't help but notice the sibling pair manning the food sample table. The Teenage Girl was ever-cheerful, scooping samples of ice cream into little cups for customers. Her brother, the Teenage Boy with the fiery pyrokinesis, was a constant presence nearby. He kept a watchful eye, ready to deter any would-be harassers like the unkempt man with his inappropriate comments and fiery beard.

The day's most peculiar encounter, however, happened when a customer approached the display counters of the Men's Wear Department. The Young Man in red spandex, our sales associate, extended his unusually long arms to measure him with an air of professionalism. I couldn't help but feel a pang of envy - if only I could stretch my own limbs and reach down for that box I needed!

Little did I know that help was on the way in the form of The Store Employee in battle armour. His rocket boots propelled him through the air, reaching the shelves I couldn't even see from where I stood. He retrieved my box with a flourish and handed it down to me, finally freeing me from my high shelf imprisonment.

As I watched the customers stream by, one caught my eye: a lone figure clad in a plain tunic and trousers. This was The Narrator, our mystery shopper for the day. They navigated the store with ease, witnessing the strange and wondrous sights it had to offer - from the salesperson summoning the Green Fox spirit animal to retrieve items in the back stock room, to the unique self-checkout kiosks where customers could complete their purchases with a simple wave of their hands.

The Narrator eventually made their way to the checkout area, completing their purchase with an electronic scan and paying for their goods at one of the self-checkout machines. Little did they know that this was only the beginning of the store's unique offerings - for their items would soon be transported directly to their home via the magical energy ball of the "Instant Delivery" service.

And so, as the day drew to a close and the store lights began to dim, I couldn't help but feel grateful for my own unique vantage point among the high shelves of the Super Supermart. It was a place of mystery, wonder, and endless amusement - a world apart from the mundane routine below. And as the sounds of shoppers and humming machinery faded away, I prepared myself for another day of bizarre encounters and captivating scenes in this futuristic emporium of dreams.
